renderings.value: Cut the quartered pak-choi into, slightly wide, strips.
Cut the quartered Chinese cabbage into wide strips.
Heat sesame oil in the pan on a medium flame, add the chicken meat, the garlic and fry, when the colour changes pour in the Chinese soup, add the Chinese cabbage and boil.
Our sister bought some eggplants, potatoes, zucchinis and Chinese cabbage at the market.
The cabbage that was this much turns into just this little when cooked.
The cabbage that was this big becomes this small after being cooked.
